## Appearance

## Personality

A minister known for his lack of imagination, Simon Bentley is habitually intoxicated. Notably, his ability to pray powerfully improves the more he drinks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P35](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0035)_

## History

A widower who served as the minister of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for eighteen years, Bentley was known for his beautiful prayers, which were said to be best when he was drunk or hoping to be. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) notably found him lacking in imagination during his tenure. In the preceding February, he resigned from his charge and departed the parish amid the regrets of his congregation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P35](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0035)_
